nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Configuration file specifying patterns for files/directories to exclude from understand-anything analysis. Uses .gitignore-compatible syntax with glob patterns, comments, and negation support.

nodes.name: 2026-07-29-database-connection-design.md
nodes.summary: Design specification for connecting the Streak Tracker app to Supabase. Documents the migration from localStorage to a database layer, including new users table schema, Supabase client setup (browser, server, service layer), StreakContext integration changes, password handling with bcryptjs, API routes for auth, and migration strategy.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat configuration file using Next.js core-web-vitals and TypeScript presets. Configures global ignores for .next, out, build directories and next-env.d.ts.

nodes.name: next.config.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js configuration enabling reactStrictMode, compression, hiding poweredByHeader, and setting security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy).

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration using the @tailwindcss/postcss plugin for Tailwind CSS v4 integration.

nodes.name: about.html
nodes.summary: Comprehensive static HTML documentation page for Streakify. Showcases all 15+ interactive views, 5 global modals, 3 app routes, and the technical architecture. Features glassmorphism styling, animated elements, and JavaScript-based category filtering.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: PWA web app manifest defining app name (Streakify), display mode (standalone), theme color (#10b981), icons, shortcuts for Dashboard and Admin Panel, and category metadata.

nodes.name: sw.js
nodes.summary: Service Worker implementing a cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for navigation requests. Manages app shell caching with cache versioning (streakify-v1) and handles offline fallbacks.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js client component rendering the About page for Streakify. Displays architecture overview with categories (15 Interactive Views, 5 Global Modals, Android PWA & Routes) and provides link to the full HTML blueprint documentation.

nodes.name: AboutPage
nodes.summary: Default exported React component for the About page. Renders navigation with back link and full blueprint link, header section, quick access card to about.html, and three category overview cards.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js client component for the standalone Admin route (/admin). Composes the admin layout with Sidebar, TopNav, BottomNav, AdminView, and global modals (DailyCheckInModal, DayDetailsModal, HabitFormModal, NotificationsDrawer).

nodes.name: AdminPage
nodes.summary: Default exported React component for the Admin page. Renders flex layout with desktop Sidebar, main content area with TopNav and AdminView, and mobile navigation components.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for admin user management. Exposes GET (list all users), PATCH (update user details including password hashing with bcryptjs), and DELETE (remove non-admin users with cascade). All endpoints require ADMIN_SECRET_KEY bearer token authentication.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Handles GET requests to list all users. Validates Authorization header against ADMIN_SECRET_KEY, queries users table ordered by created_at descending.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Handles PATCH requests to update user details. Supports updating name, email, password (with bcrypt hashing), and status. Also updates the profiles table when name or email changes.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Handles DELETE requests to remove a user. Prevents deletion of admin users. Cascades deletion to profiles, questions, and related data.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for admin-only user creation. Hashes password with bcryptjs, creates user record, then creates associated profile, settings, and streaks records with rollback on failure. Requires ADMIN_SECRET_KEY authentication.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Handles POST requests to create a new user. Validates admin key, hashes password, inserts into users table, then creates profile, settings, and streaks records. Cleans up on partial failure.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for user login. Validates email/password credentials against the users table using bcrypt password comparison. Checks account status (suspended users blocked). Returns user data with profile on success.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Handles POST requests for user login. Parses JSON body, looks up user by email/username, verifies password with bcrypt.compareSync, checks suspended status, fetches profile data, and returns user+profile.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for fetching user achievements. GET endpoint queries achievements table by userId, ordered by achieved_at descending.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Handles GET requests to fetch achievements for a given userId from query params.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for fetching user badges. GET endpoint queries badges table by userId, ordered by earned_at descending.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Handles GET requests to fetch badges for a given userId from query params.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for daily check-in submission. POST endpoint upserts daily_completion, creates daily_answers for completed habits, updates streaks (current/longest), adds XP history, and updates profile XP/level. Core gamification endpoint.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Handles POST requests for daily check-in. Validates userId and date, upserts daily_completion, bulk creates daily_answers, updates streak counters, inserts XP history, and updates profile XP/level calculation.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for habit management. GET fetches habits (questions table) ordered by sort_order. POST creates a new habit with auto-incremented sort_order.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Handles GET requests to fetch habits for a given userId, ordered by sort_order ascending.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Handles POST requests to create a new habit. Validates userId and title, calculates next sort_order, inserts into questions table with defaults for icon, is_required, and is_active.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for fetching user check-in history. GET endpoint queries daily_completion table by userId, ordered by completion_date descending.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Handles GET requests to fetch daily completion history for a given userId.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for fetching user notifications. GET endpoint queries notifications table by userId, ordered by created_at descending.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Handles GET requests to fetch notifications for a given userId.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for fetching user profile. GET endpoint queries profiles table by userId, returns single profile record.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Handles GET requests to fetch profile for a given userId from query params.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js client component for the PWA download page (/download). Handles beforeinstallprompt event for PWA installation, detects standalone mode, displays install button with APK fallback, and showcases app features (instant loading, native feel, offline support, auto-updates).

nodes.name: DownloadPage
nodes.summary: Default exported React component for the Download page. Manages deferredPrompt state for PWA install, detects standalone mode, renders app card with install/APK buttons, and feature grid.

nodes.name: handleInstall
nodes.summary: Async function that triggers the PWA install prompt, awaits user choice, and updates installed state on acceptance.

nodes.name: error.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js App Router error boundary component. Displays a styled error card with the error message, a 'Try Again' button that calls reset(), and a 'Go Home' link. Logs unhandled errors to console.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Default exported React component acting as the App Router error boundary. Accepts error and reset props, logs error on mount, renders error UI with retry and home navigation.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS file for the Streakify app. Imports Tailwind CSS v4, tw-animate-css, and shadcn/tailwind.css. Defines CSS custom properties for theming (default dark, .theme-amoled, .theme-light), glassmorphism utility classes (glass-panel, glass-card, glass-modal), glow effects, custom scrollbar styles, and fire/pulse keyframe animations.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js root layout component. Configures Geist fonts, viewport theme color, comprehensive metadata (OpenGraph, Twitter cards, robots, icons), JSON-LD structured data for SEO. Wraps children in StreakProvider context and ErrorBoundary. Registers service worker.

nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Default exported React component for the root layout. Renders html/body with Geist font variables, StreakProvider wrapping, ErrorBoundary, and ServiceWorkerRegister.

nodes.name: loading.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js App Router loading UI component. Displays a pulsing animated flame icon with 'Loading Streakify...' text while pages are loading.

nodes.name: Loading
nodes.summary: Default exported React component for the loading state. Renders centered flame icon with pulse animation and loading text.
